label: Editorial
summary: Components behave like parts of a printed feature: text buttons with rules or underlines, headings with numbered eyebrows, figures with captions, forms set as clean labelled lines.
allowed: custom button treatment: square or near square, text led, a rule or underline that moves on hover
custom card treatment: no box, a top rule, a number or eyebrow, a heading and a short paragraph
custom header: masthead wordmark with small tracked links
custom section compositions: offset columns, full width figures, numbered sections
figure captions set small in the body face
hairline rules (1px, the line token) as structure
forbidden: default shadcn card appearance (bordered rounded box with shadow)
icon grids of three or more identical feature cards
drop shadows as the main way of separating content
